title: Tournament Registration Form
subtitle: Capture division, team or entrant, bracket, and credential; confirm venue assignment and result acceptance.
description: Tournament records division, team or entrant, bracket, credential, venue assignment, and result acceptance. Tournament evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tournament registration and placement when staff must document division and team or entrant. Reconcile bracket, credential, venue assignment, and result acceptance before the tournament handoff. Use the division rules, entrant roster, bracket version, credential list, venue assignment, official scorecard, protest record, standings update, and award receipt. This record manages active competition through entrants, officials, court or field rotation, scorecards, standings, protests, advancement, awards, and result acceptance. Ask the assigned tournament reviewer to confirm division against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tournament registrant details
sections.guidance: Connect entrant or team to division, bracket, venue court or field, credentials, schedule, official result, protest route, and award acceptance.

sections.title: Tournament requested options and readiness
sections.guidance: Record requested options, prerequisites, availability, and conditions without assuming an outcome.

blocks.label: Tournament registration readiness
items: Division is identified for this record
Team or entrant matches the current request or source
Bracket is ready for point-of-use staff
Credential limits or questions are resolved
Venue assignment is communicated to the responsible person
Result acceptance is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Tournament exception review: confirmation and next steps
sections.guidance: Confirm the accepted scope, reference, open condition, and instructions.

blocks.label: Tournament registration receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or responsible staff and date

blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms the recorded registration result and open condition.
